newsitem.title: USA: ITT EXTENDS SELF-TENDER TO SEPT 9.
newsitem.headline: ITT EXTENDS SELF-TENDER TO SEPT 9.

text.p: ITT Corp said it has extended an offer to repurchase up to 30 million of its shares at $70 each until Sept 9.
The tender offer, announced last month, had been set to expire today. ITT said approximately 19 million shares had been tendered as of the close of business on Tuesday.
ITT announced the self-tender for up to 26 percent of its outstanding stock as part of a reorganization that also calls for splitting the company into three pieces.

The move was widely viewed as an effort to thwart a takeover bid from rival Hilton Hotels Corp, which launched its effort in January. Last week, Hilton raised its $55 per share cash and stock offer to $70.
Shares of ITT fell 10/16 to 63-13/16 in midday trading.
